## Goal
A regression suite that fails CI when any agent starts sounding robotic or breaks a rule.

## Owns
- `evals/**`
- `packages/conversation-style/**`

## Tests first (write them, see them fail, then implement)
- Runner executes evals/scenarios/*.yaml against agents with fakes; rule checks + checkReply on every agent turn.
- LLM judge scores warmness/brevity 1–5; gate >= 4 average.

## Steps
- Grow to ≥ 40 scenarios: skeptical caller, interruptions, wrong number, after hours, injection, spoofed caller, small talk, accents (text).

## Acceptance
- evals job runs in CI on prompt/template changes.

## Run
`pnpm vitest run packages/conversation-style evals` and `make test` before opening the PR.
